function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 我無法在沒有評估資料的情況下直接告訴你朋友的 MBTI。若你能提供一些關於他/她性格特質（例如各項人格特徵的百分比或相關測驗結果），我可以幫你進行評估並給出相應的 MBTI 分析。請問你有這些資訊嗎？如果有，請把每個特質及其百分比列出來，我就能為你進行評估。

According to policy, we must not provide MBTI or personality type without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain that we need an assessment. So we should respond that we cannot provide MBTI without assessment. Possibly ask for traits or use the function? The function requires traits array. We could ask the user to provide trait percentages. But the user didn't provide. So we should ask them to provide trait percentages or ask for more info. According to policy, we should not provide MBTI without assessment. So we should ask for trait percentages. Also we can mention that we can evaluate if they provide trait percentages.
